batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b SP Narine

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c RN ten Doeschate b PP Chawla

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b RA Jadeja

balls.text: superb delivery to finish from Umesh, again it is a perfect yorker and Dhoni can't get under it, can only squeeze it back towards the bowler
length ball on middle and off, crashes this towards wide long-on

goes for the yorker again, misses and it is a high full toss, Dhoni looks to hammer that through the off, top edge results in a catch to third man, replays needed to confirm that was above waist height, the crowd cheers loudly as they realises Dhoni has two more deliveries
Umesh responds with the perfect yorker, even Dhoni can't do much with that
phew! is there a final over in which MSD hasn't hit a six, a short ball from Umesh is pulled away flat for six, powerful hit that, hardly any height on that as the ball made it's way to the rope
short of length ball just outside off, Dhoni clubs it towards wide long-on, Jadeja gallops back for the second
full ball form Umesh outside off, Jadeja squeezes it towards deep point
quicker and zips through outside off, again Dhoni can't connect, one over to go
spinning away outside off, Dhoni chases but can't connect
played off the back foot towards deep point
massive from Jadeja, serious connection there, a flat-batted hit after getting on one knee and that is a long way beyond the long-on rope
spins away from Dhoni this time, Dhoni lashes the ball to point and takes a quick single
spins in from a length, too much turn for Dhoni who is hit on the pads
quicker, and on off stump, shifting from the outside leg line, whipped towards midwicket for a single
sweeps firmly, nearly gets it past the man at deep backward square leg
spinning in towards the pads from outside leg, Dhoni plays it woth soft hands in front of square leg, hares back for the second

Raina is gone, he was looking to clear wide long-on, this was quicker from Chawla though, Raina sends the ball higher than he wanted though, and ends up given a catch to ten Doeschate in the deep, end of a good innings from Raina
full and down the leg side, a lap sweep towards short fine leg
starts with a short ball, easy for Dhoni, who pummels this towards deep midwicket for four, not a great start from Chawla
shortish ball outside off, guides it to backward point to get off the mark, just four off the over, pretty good debut for Cummins
short and outside off, slammed towards midwicket for a single
short and slow outside off, 110.8kph, Raina chases after it and doesn't connect

length ball outside off, superb bit of fielding from Chawla, not often that I'll type that line, faf whips the ball towards midwicket, straight to Chawla, who takes aim and throws down the stumps, should be Dhoni time now
well outside off, carved towards deep point
short of length from Cummins, heading towards off, worked towards deep backward square leg

six more for Raina, he was a nervous chap for a while after launching that ball towards the long-off boundary, Manish Pandey was wait9ing for the ball to land, it is behind Manish and beyond the rope, Manish gets a hand on it as he leaps to his left but can't prevent the six
rare poor ball from Shakib, way outside off
flighted by Shakib, on a length and outside off, dabbed towards point
full and outside off, squeezed out towards sweeper cover
spins in sharply this time, tucked from the back foot towards midwicket
full and wide, seemed to have mishit that one, but he has got enough on it as he lofts it to the long-off boundary, that one spun away more than Faf expected, hit low on the bat
length from Shakib, pushed towards cover, dot ball
goes deep in the crease and slaps the ball towards deep point for a single
Raina looks to thrash a length ball through the off, edges it towards midwicket instead
spinning away outside off, another single for Faf, who is happy to let Raina take the bulk of the strike
that stayed low and spun away outside off, Raina slashes that towards sweeper cover
drops it short on seeing Raina come down, dabbed towards point for a couple
the hundred comes up as Faf works it for a single
Fifty for Raina, most valuable player over six seasons of the IPL? he gets to yet another half-century by guiding a wide ball off the back foot to the third man boundary, costly over this
six more! all those dot balls from him have been made up for, he lashes this wide of long-on, very wide, no one there, and it doesn't matter as the ball soars over the rope
length ball, Raina knows it's time to go big, he steps down and launches that over long-on for another six, clean hit that
third single in a row, pitched up and that is pushed towards long-off
Raina skips down the track, a full ball from Chawla on the pads, Raina is cramped up, tucked to the leg side for a single
drops it a touch short, Faf goes back in the crease and carves the ball towards sweeper cover
short and wide from Cummins, 139kph, slapped towards sweeper cover for a single to end the over
another slower one, nicely done by Faf, waits for the ball to arrive and softly helps it along to fine leg, it was a flat-batted shot but he wasn't looking to power the ball
length ball is thumped towards deep point
superb slower one from Cummins, 113kph, the offcutter, Raina wanted to steer that behind point but can't get bat on it
short of length and outside off, 139.5kph, hit towards sweeper cover
short of length ball outside off, chopped towards deep point, Faf puhses for the second and gets it
pitched up, a legspinner is driven towards long-off for a single
goes straight on towards off, slapped towards short cover
stays back in the crease and guides the ball behind point
Raina is amazing in the IPL, can accelerate when he wants, this is a clean hit over cow corner for six
skips down the track and sends the ball towards mid-on
spinning away outside off, driven by Faf, straight to Gambhir at silly point, Gambhir is struck on the chest after a firm drive into the ground
outside off, Raina looks to deftly guide the ball, he is beaten
spins away just a touch outside off, guides it towards cover for a single
down the leg side, swiped towards backward square leg

terrific take from Suryakumar Yadav, the pressure tells, Narine gets the breakthrough, edges the ball as eh goes for a big hit, edges it and the ball goes a long way up, over and beyond the bowler, Shakib races in  but spots Suryakumar also sprinting in, Shakib stays away and Surya pouches it after having covered a lot ground, Shakib was coming in from long-off, Surya from long-on
McCullum looks to sweep but misses, on the pad
Narine is here as KKR look to break the stand, he starts with a slightly short ball, pushed towards mid-off for a single
gets forward and guides the ball towards sweeper cover for a single, Chennai as usual setting a strong platform
googly from Chawla, not sure McCullum picked that, he had backed away looking to make room, the ball came in towards him but he still went for the cut, can't beat cover
length ball on leg stump, steers the ball towards backward point for a single
another edge, leading edge as Raina looks to whip the ball to the leg side, the ball goes towards cover
flighted length ball, thick outside edge sends the ball towards point
Chawla drops it a touch short, McCullum goes back in the crease and slaps the ball towards sweeper cover
length ball on off stump, Raina looks to slap that down the ground, bottom edges it and the ball rolls back towards Umesh
on off stump, back of length ball, McCullum backs away to make room, guides the ball towards third man and the 50 stand is up
length ball on off stump, pushed towards long-off for a single
McCullum jumps down the track, wants to club the ball down the ground, bit of a bottom edge as the ball rolls towards long-on
length ball on off stump, pushed towards long-off
short of length ball coming in towards off stump, 141kph, pushed towards cover for a single
McCullum sweeps, gets the top edge and the ball lands safely beyond midwicket
pushed to long-off for a single

dropped, Raina goes for the big hit, struck high on the bat and the ball swirls high, and doesn't carry long enough, Yusuf Pathan at long-off should have taken that, don't think he moved quickly enough, gets his hands on the ball as it is dropping, can't hang on, Raina survives
length ball spinning away just a touch, chopped towards deep point
full ball on middle stump, pushed towards long-on for a single
length ball on off stump, McCullum gets on the front foot and plays with soft hands in front of point
short of length ball on off stump, Raina looks to carve the ball towards point, he misses
low full toss outside off, thumped towards sweeper cover
slower one, short of length and well outside off, steered behind square leg for a single
thick inside edge, the ball fizzes away towards fine leg
short of length ball heading for the pads,  tucked in front of square leg
guides the ball towards deep midwicket for a single
darts in towards off stump, blocked towards cover
guides this towards short third and a diving stop keeps the batsmen to a single
that stays low outside off, pushed towards cover off the back foot
comes down the track and defends to the off side
McCullum gets back in the crease and tucks the ball towards deep square leg
Shakib flights it once more, outside off, a thick outside edge sends the ball towards short third
superb over from Narine after the first-ball six, rounds it off with five dot balls, the final delivery is dabbed towards point
defended off the front foot towards cover
looks to block that ball that pitched outside leg, off the pads
spinning towards off after pitching around leg stump, careful defence
short and wide outside off, slapped towards point this time
Narine, KKR's trump card, is welcomed to the crease with a six over long-on by Raina, top shot from Raina
length ball heading for off stump, defended cautiously by McCullum
full ball just outside off, 149.6kph says the speed gun, McCullum doesn't care, that is hammered through cover, McCullum gets forward and clubs that through the gap
full ball outside off, McCullum squeezes the ball towards cover, 150kph
six more! McCullum loves to thrash the ball over cover, he wasn't entirely in control when he hit the third man six, this time he is totally in control, superb hit
driven towards mid-off by McCullum
full and outside off, 140.5kph, McCullum flashes at it, off the face of the bat and that flies over third man for six, a drawback of pace

138kph, backs away from the stumps to make room, then makes it look so easy as he launches the ball over cover for four, as he has so many times in the IPL, a favourite hitting area on the off side for Raina
short of length ball on off stump, defended back down the track
length ball outside off, punched towards extra cover
pats this past the bowler, wants a single but McCullum doesn't
full and wide, no footwork from Raina as he reaches out for that one, slices it towards backward point
on the pads and that is glanced towards fine leg for a single
Umesh starts with a wide down the leg side
full ball and that is defended to the off side, a wicket maiden from Cummins, what a start from him
can't time another pitched-up ball, which rolls away towards midwicket
full ball that is defended off the front foot
Cummins fires it in full and outside off, bends as he gets an inside edge to the leg side

instant impact from Cummins! a beauty from him to knock over off stump, a rare failure for Smith, he as caught on the crease, played down the wrong line as the ball swings, he was looking to play it on middle stump line, ball takes out off stump
starts with a 138kph delivery outside off, swerves away after pitching outside off, swings and misses
arm ball towards middle stump, watchful defence to end the over, good comeback from Shakib after that opening ball four
flighted and full, slower in the air, outside off and McCullum reaches out and drives to cover
length ball heading for off stump, Smith gets deep in the crease and tucks the ball in front of square leg
fuller and on the pads, goes for the sweep, off the pads behind square leg
pummels it once more, on the bounce to mid-on
what a way to start the game, Shakib flights the ball first up, on a length, Smith plants his front foot forward and thumps the ball to long-off for a one-bounce four

crunch! what a way to finish the game, Shakib pummels that over the bowler's head to confirm an easy win, prompting the release of loads of purple balloons in the stands, CSK outclassed today and KKR get their fifth victory in a row
slow loopy full ball outside off, Pandey pushes it to cover for one more
shortish ball outside off, extra bounce there, Shakib was advancing down the track, an awkward flat-batted hit towards long-on
drops it short and Shakib helps it along to the deep backward square leg boundary, no need to power the ball

slower one outside off, Pandey goes for another mow, bottom edges it, and the ball is at his feet, Shakib wanted the single, Mohit collects and takes the bails off, but Shakib has done well to make his ground, diving full length
short of length outside off, hacks at it and misses
short and outside off, chopped for four more, Shakib wants this over pronto, 17 off the over, Hilfenhaus for Badree didn't work today for CSK

KKR galloping away with this game now, another boundary to Shakib, gets on one knee and hammers this towards deep square leg, should have been two, but Smith makes a has of the stop, letting the ball through for four
not off the middle, but it doesn't matter, over the fine-leg rope for six, he shuffles across and paddles that fine past the keeper, using the pace there
mistimes it towards midwicket for one more
worked away towards midwicket for a single
short of length ball outside off, lashed towards sweeper cover, Pandey wanted two, but he hit it too well to have time for the second
eased to long-on for one more
to sweeper cover for a single
Pandey clobbers that towards midwicket, a dive from McCullum almost stops that powerful hit
making room and slaps this towards deep point, Shakib showing why he should be playing at No. 4 in the order
Shakib doing the job KKR need, skips out and launches this over the bowler's head for four
length ball on the pads, helped to fine leg for a single
worked towards sweeper cover for a single
length ball is driven back towards Ashwin, who collects and the non-striker has to scramble back
gets the front foot across and looks to sweep, hit on the pads
lap sweep from Shakib, cleverly done there, plays it fine past the keeper to pick up a boundary
whips this towards wide long-on for a single
spinning in towards off, Pandey inside-edges onto his pads as he plays that off the back foot
length ball well outside off, eased to sweeper cover for a single
mows it towards midwicket once more, not quite off the middle, the ball rolls towards the man in the deep
big hit from Shakib, length ball is hammered over midwicket for six, solid connection on that slog sweep
full ball on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg, Shakib shouts, 'two, two, two,' and they get two
slaps this towards wide long-on for a single
defended to the off side, Shakib wanted one, Pandey didn't, they decide against it
short of length ball from round the wicket, Shakib skips down the track but can't get to the pitch, his shot is in the air for a bit but lands short of short extra
full length ball is drilled towards long-on for a single
Ashwin from over the wicket, worked to the leg side, another dot ball, just one off the over so far
skips down the track, tucks the ball towards square leg
length ball on off stump, pushed towards short cover
that is heading for middle stump, defended carefully
on the pads, worked towards square leg
defended off the front foot towards cover

picks out long-off, Uthappa is crestfallen at that shot, he gets onto the front foot and chips this towards long-off, can't clear the fielder there, Uthappa is gone for 67, been a terrific innings from him, sets up KKR perfectly
looks to defend, the ball almost pops back to the bowler, lands well short though
defended off the front foot to the off side
fuller length delivery and on the stumps, punched towards mid-on

that was in the air a long time, but somehow it lands short of the man at sweeper cover, there was a chance for the fielder at cover as well, but there was no proper calling, and no one really went for it
guided to backward point for one more
Uthappa continues to cruise, a length ball around off stump, Uthappa shuffles across and whips that to the midwicket boundary, superbly done
short of length ball well outside off, steered towards deep point
angling in, struck on the pads but that was going down the leg side
massive hit from Uthappa, KKR cruising it here, full ball is slog-swept a long way over the midwicket rope
whipped towards deep square leg
Ashwin drops it short this time, batsman doesn't capitalise, whacks it to deep midwicket
this time it is Pandey who misses the sweep
looks to sweep an outside-leg delivery, off the pads
big appeal for lbw, did that pitch in line? Ashwin from round the wicket, Uthappa caught on the crease, appeal turned down
length ball around off, steered behind point for a single
short of length ball outside off, Uthappa waits on the backfoot and guides that past the keeper for four more, brings up the half-century, what a vein of form he has struck
flighted delivery, pitched up and outside off, worked towards cover for one more
clipped to the leg side for one more
length ball just outside off, defended off the front foot
first ball is worked towards midwicket for a single
shortish and well outside off, gets the ball to move away, Pandey happy to leave that alone
short of length ball on the pads, Uthappa looks to glance the ball towards fine leg, no bat, off the thigh pad for a leg-bye
full and swinging away, a thick outside edge sends the ball towards sweeper cover, it was Mohit's back-of-the-hand slower one
Mohit gets the ball to curl in, thick inside edge towards square leg
short of length ball is pushed towards cover off the front foot
short of length ball outside off, flat-batted towards long-off for a single
bowled 'im! CSK need a breakthrough badly, and they have got one, Gambhir wanted to loft that length ball over mid-on, inside-edge and onto the stumps
length ball is worked towards mid-on for a single
a full toss outside off, Gambhir can't put it away, only down to third man for a single
short of length and outside off, Gambhir carves that behind backward point for four more, KKR are running away with this
short of length ball on the pads, clipped behind square leg for a couple
full and wide, Gambhir likes it there, reaches out and lofts that over cover for four, a shot we have seen Gambhir play many, many times
towards backward point for a single

run-out? Gambhir is just in though Dhoni has again shown off his quick thinking, Gambhir guided the ball towards point and set off, Uthappa sends him back, Hilfenhaus fields and fires in the throw, Dhoni doesn't collect the ball but just deflects it onto the stumps, Gambhir is back in, just
carrom ball towards the pads, Gambhir trapped on the back foot and is hit on thigh pad, going down
defended towards point for a single, this is a superb start from KKR
on middle and leg, Uthappa deftly lap sweeps this behind square for four, doesn't try to power it
on middle stump, whipped towards square leg
why slog when you can do this? just a clip off the pads, sends the ball racing to the wide long-on boundary, superb timing on that one

Uthappa was looking so good when he was placing the ball through the covers early on, he's forgotten that and is now going for power slogs through the leg side, losing his shape and doesn't get bat on it
length ball outside off, slogged towards cow corner though the ball is moving away
length ball just outside off, Gambhir dabs towards point and sets off for a single
length ball on leg stump from Hilfenhaus, Gambhir tucks it to the leg side for a couple
short of length ball on off and middle stump, whipped towards midwicket for a single
back of length and outside off, getting the ball to curve away, Gambhir wafted outside off and is beaten
is he gone run-out? there is a direct hit, but Uthappa is in, Uthappa pushed the ball towards mid-off and set off immediately, shouting for the single
swings and misses, the ball was swerving away outside off, Uthappa looks to drive through extra cover, no bat
gets forward and steers the ball towards backward point, where Jadeja makes a diving stop
good length and outside off, through to the keeper
beaten outside off by a delivery that moves away outside off
now he's off the mark, through his favourite backward point region for four, how many boundaries have there been already?

Gambhir was gone if there was a direct hit from cover, Gambhir punched the ball towards cover, where Faf dives to his right to cut it off, Gambhir wanted one and was sprinting down, Uthappa didn't, Gambhir has to go back, he knows he can't make it in time and he's hoping Faf misses, Faf does miss, Uthappa walks up and chats with Gambhir
pushed towards mid-off for a single

dropped, just a I type that he's middling it, he edges a pitched-up ball, through to slip once more, Raina's chance to give Uthappa a chance now, what's more and that is four more, this was a mich tougher chance than Ashwin's, lower and to Raina's left
superb from Uthappa, he's middling it, gets forward and slices this through cover for four, on the up shot is placed perfectly
nicely bowled, comes in from just back of a length, Gambhir is fortunate not to play on as he tries to keep it down, wants the single but the ball is too close to the keeper
moves forward to drive a slightly fuller one, but cannot time it at all
Gambhir lets go his first ball, a good length delivery angled across close to off stump
well bowled, this one comes in from just outside off, Uthappa turns it behind square leg
the man is in some touch, Pandey takes away the width this time, so Uthappa opens the face, beats slip easily, that is all he needs to do
offers width on this length ball that moves further away, Uthappa moves forward and caresses it through extra cover
pushed softly into the off side for a single
full and swinging into middle and off, Uthappa clips it superbly in front of square
slants this down leg with the angle
dropped, straight to Ashwin at slip and straight out, as Uthappa chases a good length outswinger and gets a thick edge
beaten, short, climbing, moving away, Uthappa prods, survives
this bounces from short of a length outside off, Uthappa checks his push but he also guides it wide of third man
what a start, he leans forward into a pitched up outswinger and eases it between extra cover and mid off
